target_series.label: Great Britain Westminster voting intention
target_series.policy: Only records verified against a pollster's original release may update this series. A source directory, search result, Wikipedia row or social post may discover a poll but cannot verify it.

Survation.publication_pattern: archive entry with linked data tables

YouGov.publication_pattern: voting-intention article with linked results tables
YouGov.note: Record whether the published headline is modelled or tabulated; do not substitute the raw table for the headline.

Lord Ashcroft Polls.exclusion_reason: Uses a likelihood-to-vote threshold rather than the target series' standard Westminster voting-intention measure.
